title: Skill
description: Metadata for a single AI agent skill. Validated from skill.yaml in the canonical skill source directory.

name.description: Unique skill name within its namespace. Lowercase alphanumeric words separated by hyphens.

namespace.description: Logical grouping namespace. Defaults to 'default' when omitted. Lowercase alphanumeric words separated by dots, underscores, or hyphens.

version.description: Skill version. Must be stable SemVer (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) with optional prerelease and build metadata. Must match the VERSION file exactly.

description.description: Short human-readable description of what the skill does. Must be non-empty.
examples: Reviews GitLab security policies and approval policy YAML.

compatible_with.description: List of agent platforms this skill is compatible with. Must contain at least one entry. Use 'all' to indicate universal compatibility.

entrypoint.description: Relative path to the agent-readable entrypoint file within the skill package. Conventionally 'SKILL.md'.

owners.description: Team or individual identifiers responsible for maintaining this skill.

license.description: SPDX license expression for the skill. See https://spdx.org/licenses/

tags.description: Searchable tags for the skill. Lowercase preferred.

security.description: Declarations about the skill's security posture. Used by orchestrators to gate skill execution.

requires_network.description: True if the skill requires outbound network access during execution.

requires_secrets.description: True if the skill requires access to secrets or credentials.

writes_files.description: True if the skill writes files to disk beyond its own workspace.

runs_commands.description: True if the skill executes shell commands or subprocesses.

metadata.description: Freeform extension metadata. Not validated beyond being an object. Use for tool-specific or org-specific fields that do not belong in the core schema.

examples.name: gitlab-policy-reviewer
examples.description: Reviews GitLab security policies and approval policy YAML.
